reviews.comment: She is such a great professor. I took her for Human Sexuality and even though the content can be un-comfy, she made it very easy to talk about. Some people say she uses politics in class...she doesn't. Exams are textbook heavy, but you can get by with a fine grade without reading the whole thing. Don't bring friends to class, she'll kick them out.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. B is amazing. I took her for human sexuality and loved that class. She has a way of making potentially uncomfortable topics fun and engaging. Class itself isn't too hard. I'd recommend reading the textbook but you could get by without it. Attend class 100% even though it isn't mandatory.

Never again will I take a class with this professor. The class was interesting enough and you knew what was expected of you. I actually enjoyed class. I would and will never take her again. If you want to be accused of cheating, when you DID NOT, this is the perfect professor for you.

Do not take her!! Either take Dr. Edens or do not take it at all! There is hardly any information on the exam that are taught in class. She uses the lecture as a way to express her political opinion instead of teaching content. Everything on the exam is from the textbook, which is too long. The exam questions are very subjective and hard :/

I would absolutely not recommend taking this professor! Despite doing the absolute bare minimum when lecturing and as a professor, she likes to go out of her way to give bad grades and then will proceed to make jokes about it if brought up. Extremely disrespectful, and I think that some adjustments should be made to the class criteria!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr Bergman gives interesting and intriguing lectures. Attendance is not mandatory but sometimes she mentions things in class that aren't on her slides. The homework is very easy but her tests can be quite tough.The exams are all multiple choice and there are almost always at least 2 options that are super similar.

Dr. Bergman is awesome and a very entertaining speaker. She does a great job with teaching the course, but the content and the in-class discussions can sometimes be uncomfortable. I would recommend but be ready for a lot of textbook reading. Not hard but not necessarily an easy A.

Dr. Bergman is truly an amazing professor. She is very knowledgeable and extremely open minded. I will say, for this class, she does not cover all the material in the lectures so you ABSOLUTELY need to read the textbook to do well. Otherwise, the exams are straightforward and she gives easy assignments to help your grade.

she was VERY helpful in and out of class and helped me figure out what I want to do post-college outside of class too. The class is a really good introduction as to what you can do with a psychology degree and she goes VERY in depth! plus she's really funny!

The grade is based on exams, short-essay questions, quizzes, and mini-papers. Read the textbook, or at least study/memorize the answers in the quiz/review section at the end of each chapter, and look over the slides, and you'll do very well. Very nice lady.

This class is not an "easy A" but it's definitely doable if you read the textbook. The material itself is very interesting and easy to grasp. Dr. Bergman makes everyone feel comfortable in this class despite the somewhat awkward topics that we go over. This is one of those classes that will benefit you throughout your entire life, highly recommend!

Very easy and very interesting class. You'll benefit immensely from reading the textbook. Weekly quizzes, 4 tests, short answer questions, and 3 short papers. Not a hard class, do the work and put in the effort and you'll get an A. She's very nice and understanding.

To do good in this class you HAVE to read the textbook and take good notes on it. Attendance is not really required to do well because she only talks vaguely abt what's in the textbook. i never took notes in class. You will have to put work in for an A, but it's very doable. one-try quizzes and a mini write (short paragraph) for each chapter.

I would take Dr Bergman over and over if I could! She's an incredible professor - her grading criteria is clear and she does everything in her power to ensure you make a great grade. Sometimes the material can be uncomfy or awkward, but Dr Bergman and her teaching assistants are wonderful at combatting this. Take this class! You won't regret it!

This was a great class and I loved Dr. Bergman. She made more uncomfortable material really interesting and easy to learn about. There were a lot of class discussions and chances to participate. I would highly recommend taking this course, just make sure you are comfortable with having discussions and learning about the material the course covers.

Dr. Bergman is extremely caring and friendly. She genuinely loves her students. The class is simple, but you do have to read the chapters for weekly quizzes and the chapters can be pretty long, yet interesting. There are no tests, but other small assignments. Attendance is sort of mandatory because there are "in-class check-ins". Overall great clas
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: She is my favorite professor I have ever taken! Her class is super easy. Every week there is one quiz and a mini write (one paragraph) over the textbook chapter. If you read the book, you'll pass easily. She is willing to work with you on anything. She drops the lowest quiz. There are 3 short papers over the semester and they are so easy! Easy A!!

She finds a way to talk about sex without it being awkward. This is not an easy A but an A is 100% achievable if you read the textbook, study, and complete all the mini writing assignments. Her test were more difficult than I thought they would be but after the first test, you get used to her style. Class was never boring!

Dr.B is my favorite prof at TAMU. I did poorly on my first exam (73) , after only attending 75% of lectures for it. After that, I attended all lectures and never made less than a 95, and pulled an A in the course. The material is not hard if you READ and GO TO CLASS. Simple A. She's engaging, funny, and easy to listen too

Although I hoped to do better on the exams than I did(they were tricky), I loved this class solely because of the prof. She's easy to listen to and always willing to help or just talk about anything! She made me want to come to class and made learning easy.

I loved going to her classes. She made a VERY awkward class feel more comfortable and safe and even humorous. I had personal issues the semester I had her and she was very willing to help me through it and to help me keep up with the class. She was great. Read the textbook and go to lectures and you'll get an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Bergman is one of my favorite professors. She is funny and lighthearted about the squeamish parts of the 210 class, but is serious about heavy issues. She really cares if you learn the material. Gives practice tests, tests themselves are straightforward and never try to trick you. Use learning objectives in the textbook to know what will be tested.

Dr. Bergman makes the lectures more entertaining with her sense of humor! Attendance isnt mandatory, but will definitely help on exams. 1 small written assignment p/chapter that is graded on completion. Additional assignment of attending an on-campus event related to the subject + writing a summary. Tests are fair, but you need to read the textbook

Dr. Bergman is definitely one of my favorite professors at A&M. Her class was super interesting and she made the class lots of fun because she is so funny. She really took the time to get to know her students because she calls everyone by name when they raise their hands. Attendance isn't mandatory but it is a fun class that makes you want to come

Dr. Bergman is a great prof. Shes hilarious and definitely keeps class interesting. Some of these reviews says shes mean but after a semester, i have yet to see her be even slightly rude. She grades an A on the semester as an 86. If you read the textbook and pay attention in class, it won't be hard. i would definitely take her again and recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: She's a little odd, but her lectures were very interesting. I always studied only on the night before our exams and still made high As, just by reading the book carefully and taking notes while doing so, and studying my notes from class. Her quizzes weren't that hard, and she sometimes recycles questions from them in exams.

This is probably the greatest professor ever! She is a little tough on tests but only because she wants you to know the material. She is extremely helpful on anything you need even if its not for that class. These other reviews are ridiculous and they obviously did not try in this class. Lectures are not mandatory, but she makes it fun! Take her!!!
Class is very hard. Dr. Bergman is grumpy and unhelpful outside of class. Questions on tests and quizzes are unclear and confusing. A lot of studying is required.

This class was much more difficult then I had anticipated. Even after spending an hour a day on the material I scored no higher than a C on all of my exams. The questions on the exams are ambiguous and not well-defined. Psychology in my opinion is a "soft science" and many questions on the exam are ripe for debate.
Way to hard. Also very grumpy and not helpful outside of class. Lectures are good, but that is about it.
Makes tests way harder than they need to be!! Expects way to much for an Intro class. No curve at the end of the course.

Love this professor but she was very hard! Attendance isn't mandatory and she posts her powerpoints online but I would highly recommend going to class as she sometimes says things that aren't on powerpoints but are on the exams. Reading the textbook is a necessity if you want to pass. I got an A but it took a huge amount of studying to do so.
Makes class interesting and wants kids to succeed and do well. However, the textbook must be read for this class and the tests are very in depth. Not an easy A.

Was funny, kept class interesting. Slides posted online prior to class but she goes more in depth during class. Expected to read textbook but she is very helpful. Wants kids to do well in class, has a built in curve taking only the highest quizzes and writing assignments
Has an attitude problem. Need to read to do well on tests and take lots of notes from class. All tests have essays
Take good notes and be prepared for many essays on EVERY test.
